findings.highlight: Since the after-school clubs have been cancelled
findings.evidenceJa: 今日から放課後の部活動もすべて禁止され
findings.governingReading: beginning today, every after-school club activity is prohibited as well
findings.explanation: mirror moon drops the start point, total scope, and institutional prohibition.

findings.highlight: I look around
findings.evidenceJa: 軽く見回してみた
findings.governingReading: he gives the area a quick, casual scan
findings.explanation: The light, unobtrusive manner of Shirou’s search for Rin disappears again in the alternate branch.

findings.highlight: she’s already heading to the Matou household
findings.evidenceJa: とっくに間桐邸に向かったのだろう
findings.governingReading: he supposes Rin has long since set out for the Matou residence
findings.explanation: The same conjectured earlier departure again becomes current travel.

findings.highlight: Sakura’s not around
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は見当たらないか
findings.governingReading: Can I not find Sakura?
findings.explanation: Shirou’s searching, uncertain self-question becomes a categorical statement.

findings.highlight: Sakura should head straight to my house
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮邸に帰るしかない
findings.governingReading: Sakura has no option but to return to the Emiya residence
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds “straight” and replaces Sakura’s established return destination with Shirou’s possessive “my house.”

findings.highlight: I didn’t promise to go home with her
findings.evidenceJa: 一緒に帰ろうと待ち合わせてもいなかった
findings.governingReading: they had not arranged to meet so they could return together
findings.explanation: Absence of a meeting arrangement becomes absence of a promise.

findings.highlight: slowly losing its liveliness
findings.evidenceJa: 見えない所から活気を失っている
findings.governingReading: seems gradually to be losing vitality beginning in places out of sight
findings.explanation: The hidden, spatially spreading nature of the town’s decline disappears.

findings.highlight: It feels like nausea
findings.evidenceJa: 貧血の類か、頭がサアーと冷えたような感覚
findings.governingReading: an anemia-like sensation as though his head suddenly goes cold
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces the cold, blood-draining head sensation with nausea, which appears separately later.

findings.highlight: A faint buzzing reaches my ears
findings.evidenceJa: 何かの共鳴音が響いている
findings.governingReading: some kind of resonant tone echoes beside his ears
findings.explanation: Resonance and echo are reduced to a faint buzz arriving at the ears.

findings.highlight: the enemy should have a hard time launching an ambush
findings.evidenceJa: たとえ敵に襲撃されようと、セイバーがいる限り、易々と敵の思い通りにはならない
findings.governingReading: even if the enemy attacks, while Saber is present they should not easily achieve what they intend
findings.explanation: Saber’s expected resistance after any attack is narrowed to difficulty initiating an ambush.

findings.highlight: Even if we’re under attack
findings.evidenceJa: この異状が敵の襲撃によるものだとしても
findings.governingReading: even if this abnormal phenomenon is caused by an enemy attack
findings.explanation: The link between Shirou’s symptoms and his conditional attack hypothesis disappears.

findings.highlight: I fight it off, willing strength into my body
findings.evidenceJa: 必死に腕で体を支えて
findings.governingReading: he desperately supports his body with his arms so the nausea and chills do not crush him
findings.explanation: A concrete bracing action is replaced by an invented act of mentally willing strength into his body.

findings.highlight: my Command Spell
findings.evidenceJa: 左手の刻印
findings.governingReading: the mark on his left hand
findings.explanation: The left-hand location of the fading mark is omitted.

findings.highlight: I’ve already dealt with Saber
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは始末したわ
findings.governingReading: I disposed of Saber
findings.explanation: Illya’s lethal-sounding claim is softened into the ambiguous “dealt with.”

findings.highlight: have any more Servants go to their side
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントをあっちに取られる
findings.governingReading: have any more Servants taken by that side
findings.explanation: Active capture or appropriation becomes voluntary movement to the opposing side.

findings.highlight: I bear the nausea
findings.evidenceJa: 目眩を堪えながら
findings.governingReading: while enduring the dizziness
findings.explanation: mirror moon again substitutes nausea for the scene’s distinct dizziness symptom.

findings.highlight: my trump card against that person
findings.evidenceJa: あいつ用の切り札
findings.governingReading: a trump card meant for him or that guy
findings.explanation: The hostile masculine referent is neutralized while still remaining deliberately unnamed.

findings.highlight: I’ll put your mind in a puppet
findings.evidenceJa: 心はわたしの人形に入れ替えてあげる
findings.governingReading: she will replace or transfer his mind into her puppet
findings.explanation: mirror moon loses both the replacement operation and Illya’s possession of the puppet.

findings.highlight: You won’t be able to move
findings.evidenceJa: もう自分で動けなくなる
findings.governingReading: he will no longer be able to move by his own agency
findings.explanation: Loss of autonomous movement becomes generic immobility.

findings.highlight: the darkness with my senses sealed
findings.evidenceJa: 五感を封じられた闇
findings.governingReading: darkness in which all five senses have been sealed
findings.explanation: The total five-sense deprivation is generalized to unspecified senses.
